'''Tigran Jamiro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and other conflicts.

==Biography==
[[File:TigranJamiroReportsToSolo-TESB.png|thumb|left|200px|Jamiro reports to General Solo that Luke Skywalker never checked in]]
Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], Tigran Jamiro served at the Rebel Alliance military headquarters for much of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Initially serving on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], he moved with the high command to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and was still based there when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Evacuation of Yavin|attacked]] the moon following [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|the destruction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

He remained with the Rebellion, transferring to serve as Senior Logistics Officer at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. In that position, all new personnel arrivals at the base reported to him. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] prepared to leave the base with his [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] to search for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had recently went missing, Jamiro warned Solo that his Tauntaun would not make it very far before dying.

By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], he had achieved the rank of [[General/Legends|general]], and he led the New Republic forces that [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|attacked]] [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] and apprehended [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] and rogue Senator [[Pwoe]]. In Jamiro's command was [[Lilla Dade]] and his commandos and some pilots of the [[Twin Suns Squadron]], including the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Lowbacca]].

The New Republic Forces quickly discovered Thrackan Sal-Solo, and former Senator Pwoe, as well as members of the [[Peace Brigade]]. The mission proceeded well, despite some minor delays, until the arrival of enemy reinforcements by space. Lowbacca and Jaina, who had felt the threat a few moments before, had made them hurry, but they needed all the coolness of General Jamiro, capacity of the Jedi Jaina and Lowie, and shooting accuracy of the Twin Suns Squadron, in order to make it out alive and leave with their prisoners.

==Behind the scenes==
Tigran Jamiro was portrayed by [[Ray Hassett]].
